summary: Comprehensive frontend-only validation of J&H Electricidad y Plomería static landing page. All 16 requested checks pass: page loads, all sections render with correct data-testids, every WhatsApp CTA points to https://wa.me/5219934092237 with pre-filled text, every phone CTA uses tel:+5219934092237, social links (Facebook tecnicolmjc?locale=es_LA, Instagram tecnicolmjc) correct, in-page nav anchors (#servicios, #porque, #testimonios, #ubicacion) present, Google Maps iframe present with the correct business URL (Luis Miguel Jiménez), 7 schedule items render and current day is highlighted in yellow, 4 testimonials present, social proof shows '+48 reseñas 5★', '5 años de experiencia', 'Garantía total', floating WhatsApp button hidden at top (opacity 0) and visible after scroll>400px, mobile menu toggle works on 390px viewport, browser title is correct. No console or page errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: <html lang='en'> in /app/frontend/public/index.html should be 'es' or 'es-MX' since the entire content is in Spanish (i18n/SEO/accessibility).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page, no backend. All data-testids present and stable. Validated on 1920x1080 desktop and 390x844 mobile. WhatsApp links use buildWaLink() in /app/frontend/src/lib/contact.js — phone constant 9934092237, prefixed with 521 for MX. Float button toggles via scrollY>400 with opacity transition.
